user.title: Rockcore micro inverter
user.description: Address of the inverter's WiFi module (found automatically if possible) and the port Home Assistant listens on. The inverter must be running - at night it has no power.

data_description.host: IP address of the WiFi module.
data_description.port: TCP port Home Assistant listens on for the module.

socket_b.title: Send data to Home Assistant
socket_b.description:
The WiFi module can send a copy of the inverter data to Home Assistant on its second socket (socket B). The cloud connection and the RCMI app stay unchanged; the module restarts once.

Socket B now: `{current}`
New target: `{target}`
Command: `{command}`

When this integration is removed, the previous setting is restored.

error.cannot_connect: The WiFi module does not answer. At night the inverter has no power - try again in daylight.
error.configure_failed: The module did not accept the setting.
